notes: Summary: RidgeHaven is a regulated payments platform evaluating an enterprise code assistant for developer productivity. Primary requirement: IDE copilot with low-latency streaming and strong model/version pinning so internal signatures and policy checks are deterministic. Latency/throughput targets: interactive completion latency <100ms token turnaround for common completion shapes; support ~200 concurrent active developers during peak deployment windows. "Quote from CTO": "We can't have model drift affect code generation for policy-critical paths — pinning + immutable evals are musts."
